event_records.description: Lucia Ferreyra sends her unsolicited concept note to the Alder Foundation's program officer via email.

lucia_ferreyra.name: Lucia Ferreyra
lucia_ferreyra.persona_brief:
You are Lucia Ferreyra.
Lucia is the director of a nonprofit organization. She has prepared an unsolicited concept note about a potential project and intends to send it to the program officer at the Alder Foundation. She hopes for a substantive response within a month.

program_officer_at_alder_foundation.name: Program Officer at Alder Foundation
program_officer_at_alder_foundation.persona_brief:
You are Program Officer at Alder Foundation.
The program officer is responsible for reviewing unsolicited concept notes. They receive many such submissions and decide which ones to respond to substantively based on alignment with foundation priorities and available resources. They have no prior relationship with Lucia Ferreyra.

resolution.question: Will the program officer at the Alder Foundation respond substantively to nonprofit director Lucia Ferreyra's unsolicited concept note within one month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the program officer at the Alder Foundation sent a substantive response (e.g., a reply with feedback, a request for more information, or an invitation to submit a full proposal) to Lucia Ferreyra before 2026-10-01T09:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
